data.title: Towel clip
data.summary: Forceps & clamps · Small ring-handled locking clip with curved pointed tips that fixes drapes in place.
data.body:
![Towel clip](instruments/towel-clip.jpg)

_Also called: Backhaus towel clamp_

Small ring-handled locking clip with curved pointed tips that fixes drapes in place.

## Parts
- Ring handles with ratchet
- Curved sharp or blunt tips that meet

## Uses / indications
- Securing surgical drapes and towels so they do not slip during a procedure

## How to hold
Thumb and ring finger in the rings, index finger along the shanks for control; ratchet engaged/released by pressing the rings together and apart.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling
